_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: 'zero' / math words ↔ formatting junk tokens
axes.rationale: Jacobian and tuned lenses put ' zero', ' ZERO', ' Zero', ' math' and ' five' on the negative end, and the real-logit readout adds 'ZERO'; the positive end holds newline and formatting fragments plus unrelated subwords ('nez', 'pare', ' JetBrains').

axes.label: two-digit numbers (~49–65) ↔ non-numeric subword fragments
axes.rationale: Jacobian, logit and tuned lenses agree on numeric tokens such as '49', '59', '049', '51', '57', '55', '65' and '195' at the negative end; the positive end is subword fragments ('andom', 'auer', 'asan').

axes.label: fifty/sixty range numbers ↔ multilingual fragments (incl. 'twenty')
axes.rationale: Jacobian, logit and tuned lenses agree on ' fifty', ' Fifty', ' sixty', '50', '58', '59' and '60' at the negative end; the positive end is mostly fragments, with only weak low-number hints ('двад', '21').
